title: Anonymous sign-ups enabled on a production Auth instance
evidence: GOTRUE_DISABLE_SIGNUP=false in the running container env (value redacted class: config)
exploitScenario: Anyone who can reach the Auth endpoint can create an account and obtain an authenticated session.
preconditions: The Auth endpoint is reachable from the public internet.
recommendation: Set GOTRUE_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true and invite users explicitly.
